description: Every recorded sale at a street address (date, price, floor area, price per m², rooms, type), newest first, and a summary of its street with its latest other sales. Spellings are loose: "17 bis avenue de Saint-Mandé" finds "17 B AV DE ST MANDE". Without a number, the street's sales. When the street is not found, similar street names.

address.description: Street address, with its postcode or city unless place gives it (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris").

place.description: City or postcode the address is in, when the address does not say.

type.description: Property type as the source names it, e.g. "Appartement" or "Maison" in France.

name: sales_at_address
title: Sales at an address
